findings.text: 需要在 DSH 输出前检查本轮要求的人，可以为使用 Todo 的任务评估第二判断路径。
宿主停止钩子发送当前报告进行有限选择，按当前状态及持久预留决定是否补充。
固定仓库完成检查和单次提权代表源码。未执行模型、宿主和工具。
带多个独立功能组件的 DSH 原生插件。

| 依赖或条件 | 是否必需 | 用途 | 缺失或不满足时 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 兼容 DSH profile | 必需 | 接收原生生命周期 | 挂载或特定功能不可用 |
| 判断模型连接 | 启用判断必需 | 返回选择结果 | 保留主回答或人工处理 |
| 本轮 Todo 和要求 | 普通完成核查必需 | 生成复核材料 | 未用 Todo 跳过，缺原始要求报未完成 |

| 阶段 | 现金与资源成本 | 人工与时间投入 | 已知条件与未知项 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 首次 | 模型与接入费用未知 | 配置和策略确认耗时未知 | 端点、凭据、版本均需核对 |
| 持续 | 额外判断与主模型补充费用未知 | 审阅和等待未知 | 补充次数有额度 |
| 恢复 | 重试费用未知 | 排查过期和未确认操作耗时未知 | 保留主回答或人工退出 |
[Q04](#research-q04) 单独启用完成检查，用受控文本与独立验收判断收益，保留审批人工路径。

| 效果项 | 当前证据支持 | 尚不能确定 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 报告检查 | 两类选择和输入引用受约束 | 独立工件结果 |
| 补充限制 | 预留与额度在采用前核对 | 中断组合实测 |
输入预算、状态新鲜度和预留记录分别约束远端判断及采用。
[Q01](#research-q01) 把报告审阅接到宿主生命周期，并为同轮有限补充保留可追溯记录。
[Q03](#research-q03) 复核没有读工件；独立的提权功能确实可能给出单次授权。
[Q05](#research-q05) 用独立工件验收验证额外判断是否减少任务遗漏。

technical.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02) 相对人工检查，结构化判断属于有增量的集成，原创 25%；预留和新鲜度改变补充生命周期，机制 50%，中断未实测；需要 DSH 事件，迁移 25%；有界输入和结果替代多轮自由补充，简化 50%，仍需端点和配置。

business.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01) [Q04](#research-q04) 把复核和补充接进原轮次，工作流 50%，收益未验；交付仅影响报告，取 25%；有 DSH 与连接前提，覆盖 25%；没有已测经济结构增量，0%。

recommendation.reason: 希望在 DSH 停止时查漏的开发者，可以评估只开完成检查的隔离配置。相比只读主模型最终回答，插件可按当前要求和 Todo 识别一个需补充的问题。若端点不适合接收任务文本、额外轮次无益或结果不稳，应关闭该能力并回到人工验收。

scenario.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01) README 第 60–70 行有具体反复任务和材料，超过偶发便利；未测频次与重要性，不达 23 分。

advantage.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02) supervision 第 238–293 行提供可追溯的有界补充，超过简单审阅入口；没有真实交付比较，不达 19 分。

evidence.rationale: [Q03](#research-q03) workspace-approval 和 completion-report 对主要约束有直接材料，超过片段；未运行真实宿主或模型，不达 19 分。

cost.rationale: [Q04](#research-q04) README 第 84–103 行功能可独立关闭，超过退出缺口；还有版本、外部服务和检查负担，不达 15 分。

# Jev 决策插件 > 在 DSH 扩展点调用 Jev 或 Luna Decisions，支持按需监督、筛选、导航和单次审批辅助。 ## 研究范围 - **仓库**：[luobosibing2/dsh-jev-plugin](https://github.com/luobosibing2/dsh-jev-plugin) - **版本号**：0.1.0（[固定提交 93ed43565cf6b01159dc7351865060012e7a1d97](https://github.com/luobosibing2/dsh-jev-plugin/tree/93ed43565cf6b01159dc7351865060012e7a1d97)） - **版本日期**：2026-11-03（固定提交日期，北京时间；不是包发布日期） ## 结论状态 固定源码核查普通完成检查与独立审批代表路径；未复现作者运行、正确率或成本。 ## 洞察短评 - **用途**：需要在 DSH 输出前检查本轮要求的人，可以为使用 Todo 的任务评估第二判断路径。 - **亮点**：[Q01](#research-q01) 把报告审阅接到宿主生命周期，并为同轮有限补充保留可追溯记录。 - **思考**：[Q03](#research-q03) 复核没有读工件；独立的提权功能确实可能给出单次授权。 - **建议**：[Q05](#research-q05) 用独立工件验收验证额外判断是否减少任务遗漏。 采用建议：[Q04](#research-q04) 单独启用完成检查，用受控文本与独立验收判断收益，保留审批人工路径。 ## 核心贡献 [Q01](#research-q01) 把报告审阅接到宿主生命周期，并为同轮有限补充保留可追溯记录。 ## 关键质疑 [Q03](#research-q03) 复核没有读工件；独立的提权功能确实可能给出单次授权。 ## 重点创新推演与最小验证 [Q05](#research-q05) 用独立工件验收验证额外判断是否减少任务遗漏。 用合成任务统计错误接受、补充和延迟，另查中断后的状态。 ## 场景与替代办法 需要在 DSH 输出前检查本轮要求的人，可以为使用 Todo 的任务评估第二判断路径。 主模型自检几乎无需接线，人工检查工件能核实实际结果但有时间负担。 ## 依赖与流程 | 依赖或条件 | 是否必需 | 用途 | 缺失或不满足时 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | 兼容 DSH profile | 必需 | 接收原生生命周期 | 挂载或特定功能不可用 | | 判断模型连接 | 启用判断必需 | 返回选择结果 | 保留主回答或人工处理 | | 本轮 Todo 和要求 | 普通完成核查必需 | 生成复核材料 | 未用 Todo 跳过，缺原始要求报未完成 | | 步骤 | 执行者与动作 | 成功判据或失败处理 | | --- | --- | --- | | 配置 | 核对版本和判断端点 | 只开完成检查 | | 评估 | 使用有独立验收的合成任务 | 观察额外轮次和真实工件 | | 退出 | 关闭该功能 | 继续人工验收 | ## 成本与效果 | 阶段 | 现金与资源成本 | 人工与时间投入 | 已知条件与未知项 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | 首次 | 模型与接入费用未知 | 配置和策略确认耗时未知 | 端点、凭据、版本均需核对 | | 持续 | 额外判断与主模型补充费用未知 | 审阅和等待未知 | 补充次数有额度 | | 恢复 | 重试费用未知 | 排查过期和未确认操作耗时未知 | 保留主回答或人工退出 | | 效果项 | 当前证据支持 | 尚不能确定 | | --- | --- | --- | | 报告检查 | 两类选择和输入引用受约束 | 独立工件结果 | | 补充限制 | 预留与额度在采用前核对 | 中断组合实测 | ## 研究问题与完整回答 **插件研究总目标**：核查普通轮次完成检查的输入、补充生命周期和独立的提权边界。 ### Q01 · 普通轮次完成检查补充了什么？ **研究主题**：场景与需求、贡献与相对优势 #### 完整回答 希望在交付前再核对当前要求的人，可以为使用过 Todo 的普通轮次启用复核。构建器读取本轮用户要求、最新 Todo 和最终文本，再用判断与引用两个有界问题聚焦一个问题。相较只让主模型结束，它加入独立判定入口；相较人工检查真实产物，它缺少工具结果和工件，因此完整结论只评价所给报告。未使用 Todo 的普通轮次跳过。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 作者声明**：[README.md:60-70](https://github.com/luobosibing2/dsh-jev-plugin/blob/93ed43565cf6b01159dc7351865060012e7a1d97/README.md#L60-L70) 作者说明触发、字段及补充范围
查看原文（11行） ```text ## Completion checks An enabled ordinary root turn is checked at its normal stopping point only if it used Todo during that turn. Pending items and a later empty list still qualify. A turn without Todo skips the check, and a Todo update during execution does not start a check. Native Goal turns retain their own supervision. The judgment receives the current turn's original user request and later adjustments, the complete latest Todo, and the latest final answer. It excludes raw tool results, reasoning and earlier turns. A new turn saying only “continue” does not automatically import the previous task. While the feature is enabled, a short model instruction asks for actual actions, paths, commands and observed results in existing Todo content; it adds no Todo fields or requirement to create a list for a simple task. One judgment request asks two Choice questions: `assessment` chooses `complete`, `omission`, `contradiction`, `needs-user` or `unknown`; `focus` selects an existing requirement, Todo item or final-answer reference. `complete` means the supplied report appears to meet the requirements. It does not independently verify code, artifacts or execution facts. Each check identifies only the most important issue. `omission`, `contradiction` and valid `unknown` share the profile's **Maximum automatic supplement rounds** setting (`maxSupplementRounds`), default 3. The initial check is separate: a limit of N permits at most N automatic supplements and N+1 normal checks; the default permits 3 supplements and 4 normal checks. `complete` ends normally, `needs-user` stops for the user's decision, and an unresolved result at the limit ends with that last conclusion. Supplements stay in the same turn and retain existing authorization. The full input is checked against the existing character budget before dispatch. Oversized input is neither cropped nor automatically summarized. Missing original requirements, budget rejection, transport errors or invalid answers show that the completion check did not finish and wait for **Retry / Cancel**, while retaining the main answer. Retry reads current materials and saved settings. Technical retries do not count toward N+1 normal checks and neither consume nor reset supplement rounds already used. Cancel ends the check without declaring the task successful or failed. See the [package reference](packages/jev/README.md#ordinary-completion-checks) for result meanings, records and lifecycle details. ```
**依据 2 · 源码核查**：[packages/jev/src/completion-report.ts:26-54](https://github.com/luobosibing2/dsh-jev-plugin/blob/93ed43565cf6b01159dc7351865060012e7a1d97/packages/jev/src/completion-report.ts#L26-L54) 构造当前轮材料和选项
查看原文（29行） ```text export function completionReport(agent: Agent, requestId: string, supplements: number, maximum: number, budget: number): JevRequest | undefined { const events = agent.session.snapshotEvents() const start = events.findLastIndex(event => event.type === 'turn/start') const turn = events.slice(Math.max(0, start)) const todo = turn.findLast(event => event.type === 'todo/write') if (todo?.type !== 'todo/write') return undefined const requirements = turn.flatMap(event => event.type === 'user/message' && event.data.source.kind === 'user' ? [{ id: event.data.id, content: event.data.content }] : []) const originalAvailable = start >= 0 && requirements.some(message => message.id === requestId) const final = turn.findLast(event => event.type === 'assistant/message') const finalText = final?.type === 'assistant/message' ? final.data.message.content.filter(block => block.type === 'text').map(block => block.text).join('\n') : '' const options = [ ...requirements.map((message, index) => ({ id: `requirement-${index + 1}`, description: JSON.stringify(message.content) })), ...todo.data.todos.map((item, index) => ({ id: `todo-${index + 1}`, description: `[${item.status}] ${item.content}` })), { id: 'final-answer', description: finalText || '最终正文为空 / Empty final answer' }, { id: 'overall', description: '整体材料 / The complete supplied material' }, { id: 'none', description: '未发现问题 / No issue identified (complete only)' }, ] const state: Json = { mode: 'completion', reviewPoint: String(final?.seq ?? todo.seq), evidenceScope: 'current turn requirements, latest Todo and latest final answer only', requirements: requirements.map(message => ({ id: message.id, content: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(message.content)) as Json })), todos: todo.data.todos.map(item => ({ content: item.content, status: item.status })), finalAnswer: finalText, originalRequirementsAvailable: originalAvailable, supplementsUsed: supplements, maxSupplementRounds: maximum, evidenceCharacterBudget: budget, rules: 'Review the supplied report only. The original requirements and subsequent adjustments are in chronological order; later explicit adjustments apply. Todo may contain historical work, but it does not replace the current-turn user requirements. Do not infer an earlier task from a new request saying continue. Empty Todo and empty final text are valid material. Select only the single most important issue; this is not an exhaustive review. Do not infer actual tool execution or artifact correctness from self-reported completion. Tests need to pass only if the user required that condition: running and truthfully reporting failed tests can satisfy a run-and-report request; a fix-and-pass request remains unmet while those tests fail. Todo pending status alone does not establish failure. Supplements stay within existing authorization, including read-only restrictions, and must not redo unrelated completed work, fabricate results, or force completed status. Unknown calls for truthful supporting information or an explanation of what remains unverified. Plugin notices are neither new user requirements nor new authorization.', } return { state, questions: [ { id: 'assessment', kind: 'choice', prompt: 'Assess the current-turn report using the supplied rules.', options: Object.entries(assessments).map(([id, description]) => ({ id, description })) }, { id: 'focus', kind: 'choice', prompt: 'Choose the most important existing requirement, Todo entry, or final answer. Use overall for material-wide uncertainty; none is permitted only for complete.', options }, ```
**依据 3 · 源码核查**：[packages/jev/src/supervision.ts:389-416](https://github.com/luobosibing2/dsh-jev-plugin/blob/93ed43565cf6b01159dc7351865060012e7a1d97/packages/jev/src/supervision.ts#L389-L416) 在宿主轮次停止阶段调用
查看原文（28行） ```text ctx.on('agent/turn-stopping', async ({ agent, signal }) => { if (!live(agent) || signal.aborted || agent.inbox.nextStep.length > 0) return const state = stateFor(agent) const goal = ctx.goals.get(agent) if (goal?.phase === 'active') { if (!await enabled('goal-supervision')) return const revision = goalIdentity(goal) if (state.goalRevision !== revision) { state.goalRevision = revision; state.stalled = 0; state.lastRound = -1 } if (goal.roundsStarted === 0 || state.lastRound === goal.roundsStarted) return const result = await judge(agent, state, 'progress', signal) if (result.kind !== 'ok') return const assessment = assessments.get(result.operationId)! assessments.delete(result.operationId) state.lastRound = goal.roundsStarted if (assessment.value === 'progress') state.stalled = 0 else if (assessment.value === 'no-progress') state.stalled++ if (assessment.value === 'needs-user' || state.stalled >= config.noProgressRounds.get()) { pause(agent) agent.session.append('user/message', notice(state, result.operationId, 'goal-paused', 'Jev 已暂停目标 / Goal paused: ' + assessment.reason), { surfaceOp: 'append' }) await receipt(result.operationId, 'goal-paused', 'executed', assessment.reason) } else await receipt(result.operationId, 'progress-checked', 'observed', assessment.reason) return } if (state.ownsGoalTurn || !await enabled('completion-check') || !state.requestId || agent.inbox.nextTurn.some(message => message.source.kind === 'user')) return if (!state.active || state.completionChecking) return state.completionChecking = true try { await checkReport(agent, state, signal) } ```
#### 缺口 - 独立判断的质量收益未测 **影响**：无法判断是否比单模型更少遗漏 **进一步探讨**：对照同一组可验收任务的报告与实际工件 ### Q02 · 补充预算和旧结论如何处理？ **研究主题**：功能与机制、工程质量与复用 #### 完整回答 复核从持久记录统计已用和未确认补充。遇到未确认操作会写提示并返回，避免直接重放。判定前按最新材料刷新，验证输入预算和回答引用，采用前再查轮次身份及等待中的用户消息。完整或需要用户时结束，额度耗尽也结束；否则先记录补充预留，随后再检查状态并 steer 同一轮。这种先预留的方式能减少不确定执行后重复注入，代价是未确认记录可能需要人介入。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 源码核查**：[packages/jev/src/completion-report.ts:62-82](https://github.com/luobosibing2/dsh-jev-plugin/blob/93ed43565cf6b01159dc7351865060012e7a1d97/packages/jev/src/completion-report.ts#L62-L82) 缺原始要求和超预算拒绝，限制有效引用
查看原文（21行） ```text export function completionPreflight(request: JevRequest, budget: number): void { if (typeof request.state !== 'object' || request.state === null || Array.isArray(request.state) || !('originalRequirementsAvailable' in request.state) || request.state.originalRequirementsAvailable !== true) { throw new JevError('COMPLETION_INPUT_MISSING', '本轮原始要求缺失，本次完成核查未完成 / Original current-turn requirements are unavailable; completion review did not finish') } if (JSON.stringify(request).length > budget) { throw new JevError('COMPLETION_BUDGET', '核查材料超出预算，本次完成核查未完成 / Review material exceeds the character budget; completion review did not finish') } } /** Validate both bounded answers; valid unknown is a business conclusion. * @param response - normalized provider answer. * @param request - actual input defining all permitted references. * @returns the assessment and its exact selected quotation, or no verdict for invalid answers. */ export function completionVerdict(response: JevResponse, request: JevRequest): CompletionVerdict | undefined { const assessment = response.answers.find(answer => answer.id === 'assessment') const focus = response.answers.find(answer => answer.id === 'focus') if (response.answers.length !== 2 || assessment?.kind !== 'choice' || focus?.kind !== 'choice' || !Object.hasOwn(assessments, assessment.optionId)) return undefined const question = request.questions.find(question => question.id === 'focus') const selected = question?.kind === 'choice' ? question.options.find(option => option.id === focus.optionId) : undefined if (selected === undefined || (selected.id === 'none' && assessment.optionId !== 'complete')) return undefined ```
